properties.description: Fill equals independently tracked queue occupancy, with acceptance determined by pre-edge expected occupancy, including simultaneous transfers and boundary rejection.
Full is asserted exactly when the independent queue contains sixteen words.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independent queue contains no words.
Whenever the independent queue is nonempty, asynchronous output equals its oldest accepted word, including across wraparound and simultaneous transfers. Empty data is not checked.
After a synchronous reset edge, fill is zero, full is deasserted, and empty is asserted, including reset during operation.
Public occupancy stays within zero through sixteen and both status flags agree with public occupancy; unknown occupancy or status values alarm.
